w-terra-da-marca-cava-brut-natura.hook: Bone dry with no sugar added, from Penedès, where most of Spain's Cava is made.
w-terra-da-marca-cava-brut-natura.pitch: This is a properly dry Spanish fizz, crisp and light with citrus and apple, and 'Brut Natura' means no sugar is added at the end, so it's as dry as sparkling wine gets. If you like your fizz clean and refreshing rather than soft or sweet, it's perfect with oysters and anything from the sea.

w-terra-da-marca-cava-brut-natura.taste: Bone dry, crisp and light, with lemon, green apple and a gentle savoury, bready edge.
w-terra-da-marca-cava-brut-natura.grape: It is usually a blend of Spain's Cava grapes Xarel·lo, Macabeo and Parellada, which give it a fresh, crisp, citrusy and slightly savoury character.
w-terra-da-marca-cava-brut-natura.place: It comes from Penedès in Spain, where most Cava is made, and the Mediterranean warmth, cooler inland, ripens the grapes while keeping them fresh.

w-bollinger-special-cuvee-brut.pitch: This is Bollinger's house Champagne, a dry blend led by Pinot Noir with Chardonnay and Pinot Meunier, so it's fresh and lively with a little red-fruit depth. It's a famous name that tastes as good as it sounds, and it's lovely with fish and chips.

w-bollinger-special-cuvee-brut.grape: It's a blend of Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and Pinot Meunier, with the Pinot Noir bringing high acidity and a touch of red-cherry fruit.
w-bollinger-special-cuvee-brut.place: Champagne is a cool region where the grapes barely ripen, which keeps them fresh and sharp, just right for sparkling wine.
w-bollinger-special-cuvee-brut.producer: Bollinger is one of the classic Champagne producers, alongside Krug and Veuve Clicquot.

w-charles-heidsieck-blanc-des-millenaire.hook: A 2007 vintage Champagne made only from Chardonnay, and the oldest Champagne on our list.
w-charles-heidsieck-blanc-des-millenaire.pitch: This is pure Chardonnay Champagne from a single year, 2007, so it has had many years to gain nutty, toasty depth while staying fresh and lemony. If you're marking something special, this is the most remarkable bottle of bubbles we pour.
w-charles-heidsieck-blanc-des-millenaire.taste: Expect lemony freshness wrapped in nutty, toasty notes from age and a creamy texture from long resting on the yeast.
w-charles-heidsieck-blanc-des-millenaire.grape: Chardonnay is a neutral grape that takes on how it is made and aged, and with years in bottle it gains the nutty, toasty notes you find here.
w-charles-heidsieck-blanc-des-millenaire.place: Champagne is a cool region where grapes barely ripen, which keeps the wine sharp and fresh, and vintage Champagne must age at least three years before release.
